title: rosa tomentosa var. friesii
intro: Rosa tomentosa var. friesii, commonly known as Himalayan rose or Musk rose, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and stress, due to its health benefits of promoting relaxation and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Rosa tomentosa var. friesii include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
